intro: Guinea-Bissau has seen frequent military interventions in politics.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The constitution provides for an elected president and parliament, but the military seized power in November 2025. General Horta N'Tam leads the junta, which has set elections for December 2026.

chapters.title: Drug trafficking
text: Its islands have been used as a route for cocaine smuggling to Europe.

keyTerms.meaning: A seizure of power by force.
